theme: Mid-summer cool escape - the plains bake past 40C while Kashmir stays green and cool, Sonamarg's glaciers and meadows out, the Dal glass at dawn, the Lidder running fast
season: Mid-summer (16 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is on (3 Jul - 28 Aug), so the Srinagar-Pahalgam and Srinagar-Sonamarg roads run heavy and hotels fill fast - book 3-4 weeks ahead and travel within the valley between 7am and 6pm. Srinagar is cool at dawn and warm by day (~15-30C) while the plains sit above 40C; the meadows are wide and green, the Dal is glass at first light, and the Lidder is running fast for rafting. Brief afternoon showers possible.
campaign_name: Kashmir Mid-summer cool green escape [INR] - 16 Jul 2026
subject: The plains are melting, the valley is cool and green
